hero.title: Company Profile
hero.lead: Established Malaysian tissue and hygiene solutions company since 1983.

story: Unikota Holdings Sdn. Bhd. was incorporated in Malaysia on 3 August 1983.
Unikota manufactures and supplies tissue and paper hygiene products for retail, business and export requirements, including OEM and custom packaging for private-label projects.
Unikota's Malaysian brand portfolio includes Cili, Cili Padi, Wasabi, Unisoft, Aimishu, BabyLike and SUMO.

Unikota has experience supporting established retailers, distributors, corporate organisations and consumer brands through OEM, private-label and bulk tissue supply. Customer references may be discussed confidentially during commercial evaluation.
overview: Unikota Holdings Sdn. Bhd. was incorporated in Malaysia on 3 August 1983. Over more than four decades, the company has developed experience across tissue and hygiene products, own-brand supply, OEM and private-label manufacturing, customised packaging, retail distribution, corporate requirements and export markets.

qualityStatement: Unikota is the programme owner and supply partner for every OEM, private-label and retail engagement. Programmes are developed, approved and supplied to the quality, hygiene and operational requirements defined by the client — covering specification, sampling approval, packing, fulfilment and export coordination. Requirements are confirmed per programme, with documentation arranged where needed for tender or audit purposes.
